cherokee: ᎯᎠ ᎤᏙᏢᎯ ᎠᏍᏆᏗᏍᎬ ᏔᎵ ᏯᎦᏴᎵ ᏓᎳᏚ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ Hispanic Scholarship Fund manges a new version.
english: The program ended in 2016, but the Hispanic Scholarship Fund manages a new version.

cherokee: ᎢᎦᏓᏃ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏗᎪᎥ ᎾᎿ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᎢ ᎾᎿ ᏚᏃᏪᎸ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎤᏛᎾ Oklahoma State University, Rogers State university ᎠᎴ ᎾᎿ University of Tulsa.
english: Some scholarships are also specific to the institution in which a student is enrolled such as Oklahoma State University, Rogers State University and the University of Tulsa.

cherokee: “ᎾᏍᎩ ᏧᏠᏯ ᎠᏂᏃᎮᏍᎩ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏄᎾᏛᏁᎸ, ᎠᎴ ᎣᏍᏓᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ Ꮭ ᎡᎵ ᏱᏂᎦᎣ ᏱᏓᎵᎮᎵᎪ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᎨᎩᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏓᏂᏂᎳᏕᎲ ᎾᏍᏊ,” CNF Executive ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙ Janice Randall ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
english: “The matching campaign has been a huge success, and we can’t thank everyone enough for the support and encouragement along the way,” CNF Executive Director Janice Randall said.

cherokee: “ᎣᎦᏅᏔ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᏢ ᎤᎪᏛ ᎠᎵᏍᎪᎸᏙᏗ ᎾᏍᎩᏃ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏙᏗ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᎠᏎᏃ ᎠᎯᏓ ᏚᏳᎪᏛ ᎾᏍᎩ Ꮭ ᎢᎬᏌᏊ ᏱᏂᎨᏓᏛᎦ,” ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎢ Tonya Rozell, CNF ᏗᏄᎪᏔᏂᏙ ᎠᏂᏅ ᏧᏓᏘᎾᎢ.
english: “We know that there is no greater investment we can make than in the education of our youth, but the simple truth is that we can’t do it alone,” Tonya Rozell, CNF board president, said.

cherokee: 2016 ᏥᎨᏒ, ᎠᏂᏥᎩᏌ ᏛᏆ ᏧᏂᏍᏆᎸᎡᎲᎢ ᏫᏚᎪᏩᏛᏓᏁ ᎤᏔᎾ ᎳᎷᏣ ᎤᏬᏢᏅ ᎠᏓ ᏗᎦᎸᏓᎸᏗ ᎤᏩᏛᏅᎢ.
english: In 2016, he exhibited a replica of a large traditional burden basket woven of hand-split oak and hickory at the Chickasaw Nation’s Artesian Art Market.

cherokee: ᎤᎪᏛ ᏭᏕᎶᏆᎡ ᏧᏣᏘᎾ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᎢ, American Academy ᏧᏙᎢᏛ Chicago ᏍᎦᏚᎩ.
english: He refined his skills as an artist within programs in various institutions, including the American Academy of Art in Chicago.

cherokee: ᏗᏐᎢᏃ ᏚᏓᏠᏒ ᎠᎾᏓᎪᏅᏗᏍᎬ, ᏩᎴᎷ ᏧᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅ Southwestern Association ᏧᎾᏙᎢᏛ ᎤᎾᏑᏰᏎ ᏫᏓᏤᏢ ᎨᏎ ᏂᎩᏓ ᎠᏂᏴᏫᏯ ᏂᎬ ᏗᏁᎲ ᏧᎾᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎯ.
english: Among other accomplishments, Hummingbird’s work won a fellowship award from the Southwestern Association for Indian Arts Indian Market.

cherokee: Gonzales Z ᎤᏁᏎᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏚᏍᏆᏛᎢ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎤᏁᏎᎢ ᎥᎿᎾᏂ ᎤᏴᏢᎢᎧᎸᎬᎢ ᏩᎦᎸᎳᏗᎬᎢ ᏧᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏚᎩ ᎤᏌᏐᎢ ᎤᏁᏉᎢᏍᏗᎢ ᏓᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎲᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᏖᎳᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᏗᎾᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎲᏍᎩ ᎬᏂᎨᏒᎢ ᏂᏓᏅᏁᎲᎢ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᏚᎾᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎢ, ᎤᏖᎳᏗᏍᏗᎢ ᏗᎾᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎲᏍᎩ ᎠᏂᏅᏔᏅᏍᎬᎢ ᎠᎴ ᎤᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ ᎤᎪᏗ ᏄᏍᏛᎢ ᎠᏱᏙᎳᏛᎢ-ᏓᏂᎴᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᎴᏅᏗᎢ ᏕᎦᎾᏕᏴᎢ ᏧᏟᎶᏍᏔᏅᎢ ᎥᎿ ᏗᎿᏬᎢ.
english: Gonzales earned a fine arts degree from Northeastern State University and hopes to expand her art by entering more shows, attending art markets and learning more about screen-printing to start selling her designs on T-shirts.

cherokee: ᎾᏍᎩ “Mankiller” ᎪᏪᎳᏅᎯ ᎠᏥᏃᎮᏍᎬ ᎤᎬᏫᏳᎯ ᏥᎨᏒ Wilma P. Mankiller ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᏃᏪᎳ ᎤᎾᏓᏴᎳᏙᏗ ᏕᎭᎷᏱ 19 ᎾᎿ 2017 LA Film ᏓᎾᏓᏴᎳᏗᏍᎬᎢ ᎾᎿ ArcLight Cinemas.
english: The “Mankiller” documentary highlighting former Principal Chief Wilma P. Mankiller’s life was slated to premiere on June 19 during the 2017 LA Film Festival at the ArcLight Cinemas.

cherokee: Valerie Red-Horse Mohl, ᏗᎪᏢᏍᎩ ᎠᎴ ᏗᎧᏃᎯᏎ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎴᏂᏙᎸ ᎪᏪᎵ, ᎠᏗᏍᎬ “ᎠᎵᎮᎵᎬ” ᎾᏍᎩ ᎪᏪᎵ ᎾᎿ ᏛᎾᏓᏴᎳᏔᏂ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏂᏍᏆᎸᎡᎲᎢ.
english: Valerie Red-Horse Mohl, producer and director of the documentary, said she is “thrilled” the documentary will be premiered during the festival.

cherokee: “ᎢᎦ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎣᎩᏰᎸ ᎾᎿ Los Angeles Film Festival ᎣᎦᏛᏛᏅᎯ ᏲᎦᏚᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎤᏠᏅᏛ ᎯᎠ ᎠᎾᏓᎪᎾᏗᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᏃᎴᏍᏊ premiere ᎠᎴ ᏂᎬᎾᏛ ᎨᏒᎢ,” ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
english: “We’re thrilled that Los Angeles Film Festival offered us a slot in their competition and also to premiere it as a world premiere,” she said.

cherokee: ᎠᏂᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎾᏍᎩ ᎤᎾᏂᎩᏒ ᎾᏍᎩ San Francisco ᏭᏂᎶᏒ ᏂᏓᏳᎾᏂᎩᏓ ᎣᎦᎵᎰᎹ ᏙᎯᏳ ᎨᏒ ᏫᎨᏥᏌᏙᏴ ᎢᏳᏍᏗ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎠ ᎤᎾᏙᏢᎯ,” ᎠᏗᏍᎬᎢ.
english: Her family was relocated to San Francisco from Oklahoma on pretty much a forced removal program,” she said.

english: The keynote speaker for the summit will be Dr. Colleen Fitzgerald, professor of linguistics at the University of Texas at Arlington and National Science Foundation Program Director for Documenting Endangered Languages.

english: Yes, both Obstinate and Pliable;
